description: Security-reviewed capability catalog for the Chief of Staff Runtime POC. Each capability maps a tool to its MAXIMUM delegated Microsoft Graph scope. Agents may only reference capabilities defined here, and may only use a SUBSET. The union of all enabled scopes is the finite superset that is admin-consented once.

capabilities.description: Read and summarize the user's inbox and prioritize messages.
Read the user's calendar events and prepare briefings.
Read the user's recent Teams chats and summarize them.
Compose draft replies (not sent). Present but disabled in the POC.
Send email. Present but disabled in the POC; requires human approval when enabled.
Create or modify calendar events. Present but disabled in the POC.
